summary: Austin Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K on May 8, 2026, announcing the release of its 2025 Annual Disclosure Documents, including audited financial statements and an Annual Report on Form 20-F, which contain a going concern emphasis of matter from its auditor. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure required by NYSE American Company Guide Section 610(b). No merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, going-private transaction, or other special situation event is described. The filing simply updates shareholders on the availability of annual reports and the going concern note.
